name: @map-audio/mfx-mcp-server

tools.name: get_parameter_info
tools.description: Look up MFX parameter definitions from the manifest. Returns ranges, defaults, display names, and tooltips. Use this to understand what parameters are available before setting values.

paramId.description: Specific parameter ID (e.g. 'cell1_filterCutoff'). Omit for all.

cell.description: Filter by cell (e.g. 'cell1'). Returns all params for that cell.

search.description: Search term to filter parameters by name or ID.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List available MFX presets (factory and user) as an array of {name, path}. Above 400 matches it returns {presets, total, truncated, hint} instead — narrow with `search` rather than paging.

tools.name: read_preset
tools.description: Read a MFX preset file and return its state. Useful for understanding what parameters a preset uses, what samples it references, etc.

path.description: Preset file path (absolute or relative to preset dirs).

summary.description: If true, return only metadata + parameter summary instead of full state.

tools.name: get_manifest_summary
tools.description: Get a high-level summary of MFX's capabilities: number of cells, effects, modulators, and parameter counts.

tools.name: design_context
tools.description: Compact parameter-design cheat sheet for agents: the product's global controls and full per-cell effect vocabulary, value bands measured from the shipped factory presets, an underexplored-parameter list, macro targets, unit traps, LFO/delay division tables, FX chain order, MIDI cell note map, and variation slot semantics. The bands describe where shipped presets sit — they are not limits, and the distinctive end of a range is usually outside them.

cellId.description: Cell number to use for per-cell example param IDs. Defaults to cell 1.

groups.description: Narrow keyPerCellParams to these groups (e.g. ['delay','vocoder']). Omit it to get the full per-cell vocabulary.

tools.name: analyze_motion
tools.description:
Measure whether a preset actually MOVES over time, rather than whether it is mixed. No other tool on this surface can tell a modulated preset from a static one.

Reports spectral flux, brightness wander, per-bar level and brightness variation, and level movement WITHIN a bar — the last one is what catches a bar-synced gate, tremolo or sidechain pump, whose bars are all identical to each other.

Pass wavPath to a WAV of material processed through MFX, such as a DAW bounce. MFX processes its host's input, so there is no offline render to fall back on.

wavPath.description: Absolute path to a WAV of material processed through MFX, such as a DAW bounce. Required on MFX.

bpm.description: wavPath only: tempo for the 4/4 per-bar windows (default: the transport's). A render uses its own tempo and meter.

tools.name: variation_distinctness
tools.description:
Measure whether a preset's variation slots are actually different, and name what is identical about the pairs that are not. Structural comparison of the saved slot snapshots — no render, no transport, no audition loop, and no risk of the load_variation race.

Read scores against the shipped corpus, where sibling variation pairs sit at a median of 0.742 similarity (p75 0.884, p90 0.947). Siblings are far more alike than two different presets by construction, so a whole-preset novelty scale does not apply. 9.2% of shipped pairs are already near-identical — this gate exists to stop adding to that number.

Each failing pair reports the dimensions it duplicates plus the move that would fix it.

source.description: 'live' reads the running plugin's variation slots; 'file' reads them from a .preset.

threshold.description: Similarity above which a pair fails. Default 0.9 — worse than 75% of shipped sibling pairs (p75 0.884).

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read the current state of the running MFX plugin. Prefer section, keys, cellIds, or get_design_overview over an unfiltered full-state read; large full-state payloads are capped to protect agent context.

section.description: Return only a specific section of state. Defaults to 'full'. Use get_transport for transport data.

keys.description: Exact top-level state keys to return, e.g. ['cell1_filterCutoff','cell1_midiSequence'].

cellIds.description: Return only cell-scoped keys/config/modulation for these cells.

allowLarge.description: Set true to force an uncapped full-state response. Prefer filters unless you truly need everything.

tools.name: get_design_overview
tools.description: Return a compact preset-design snapshot: cells, enabled effects and order, sidechain sources, modulation link counts, mixer values, cables, cable levels, Combo assignments, band split, BPM, and transport state. Use this instead of full get_state during preset design.

cellIds.description: Optional subset of cells to include. Defaults to all cells present in the selected manifest.

tools.name: set_parameters
tools.description: Set one or more MFX parameters. Values are validated against the manifest. Effect enable flags such as cell1_filterEnabled are settable here too, so params + enables can land in one call when a graph dispatch is acceptable. Use get_parameter_info or design_context to discover valid IDs and ranges. Writing a macro_* id also enables that macro, matching the UI. Writing mfx_combo1, mfx_combo2 or mfx_combo3 also fans the value out to that combo's resolved target parameters, unless one of those targets is written in the same call.

parameters.description: Map of paramId to value. Example: { 'cell1_filterCutoff': 5000, 'cell1_filterQ': 0.7 }

tools.name: stop_cell
tools.description: Stop playback of a specific cell.

tools.name: load_preset
tools.description: Queue a preset load through MFX's native load/morph lifecycle. Returns requestId and status:'queued'. Poll get_preset_load_status until status:'succeeded' before editing, randomizing, or saving; failure, cancellation, and supersession are explicit. Replaces working state and the variation bank; save_preset first if unsaved edits matter. Requires a plugin build with tracked preset loading.

path.description: Preset file path (absolute or relative to preset dirs).

immediate.description: true bypasses the preset morph; false/omitted follows the native preset morph settings.

tools.name: get_preset_load_status
tools.description: Read the outcome of a load_preset request without requiring the plugin window. Statuses: queued, morphing, succeeded, failed, cancelled, superseded. Only succeeded confirms the world committed, including same-path reloads. MFX retains the latest 64 requests per instance; unknown/expired IDs return an error. Keep the same selected instance while polling.

tools.name: add_modulation
tools.description: Add a modulation link (LFO, envelope follower, or vary) to a parameter. The parameter must be modulatable (check with get_parameter_info).

cellId.description: Required for envelope: source cell driving the follower (1-4). This is not the target cell; target is inferred from paramId.

lfoIndex.description: Required for LFO: generator index 0-5. Parameter IDs remain 1-based (lfo1_... through lfo6_...).

pitch.description: Envelope only: route from the cell's pitch-tracked source instead of amp. false (default) = AMP; true & pitchDuck=false = PITCH (comb); true & pitchDuck=true = DUCK.

pitchDuck.description: Envelope only: when pitch=true, switch from PITCH (comb) to DUCK semantics (notch). Ignored if pitch=false.

tools.name: load_variation
tools.description: Request a switch to a saved variation slot (0-7), including parameters, effects, patterns, and modulation. Empty slots are rejected. Verify currentVariation and a slot-specific value with get_state before editing or saving.

index.description: Variation slot index (0-7). MFX UI shows these as slots 1-8.

tools.name: full_stop_transport
tools.description: Stop transport and reset playhead position to zero. Unlike stop_transport (which pauses), this resets the position so playback starts from the beginning.

tools.name: get_transport
tools.description: Get current transport state (BPM, playing, position, meter).

tools.name: new_preset
tools.description: Reset MFX to its initial/default state — equivalent to creating a new empty preset. All cells, modulation, sequences, and effects are cleared.

tools.name: save_preset
tools.description: Save the current MFX state as a preset file with metadata. Omit `name` to re-save the active user preset in place (factory presets are refused). Every save also snapshots the current state into variation slot 0 if the bank is empty, otherwise into the active slot. Writes to the user preset folder by default; pass `path` for a specific location. Use `update_preset_metadata` to edit an existing preset without re-saving plugin state.

name.description: Preset name (used for filename if `path` omitted).

bpm.description: BPM the preset was designed for.

path.description: Relative preset path (e.g. 'Presets/User/MyFolder/MyPreset.preset'). Factory paths are rejected. Defaults to user preset folder + name + '.preset'.

tools.name: save_variation
tools.description: Capture the current plugin state and save it to a variation slot (0-7). Use this to build presets with multiple variations — e.g., a build-up from minimal to full. Configure the plugin state first (set parameters, enable effects, patch cables, add modulation), then call save_variation to snapshot it into a slot. The preset must have been saved at least once via save_preset before calling this, or pass a name to create it.

name.description: Preset name. Required if the preset hasn't been saved yet. If omitted, re-saves the currently active preset.

tools.name: update_preset_metadata
tools.description: Update metadata fields on an existing preset file without touching its DSP state or the currently loaded plugin. Merges the provided fields into the preset's metadata on disk. Returns {success, newPath?} on success, or {conflict, existingPath} if a rename would collide with another preset. Factory presets cannot be modified.

path.description: Relative preset path (e.g. 'Presets/User/MyPreset.preset'), as returned by list_presets or save_preset.

name.description: New preset name (renames the file on disk).

tools.name: start_transport
tools.description: Start MFX's internal transport (begins sequencer playback).

tools.name: stop_transport
tools.description: Stop MFX's internal transport (stops sequencer playback).

tools.name: set_bpm
tools.description: Set MFX's internal transport BPM.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Check if the MCP server can connect to a running MFX plugin instance. Returns connection details or instructions for enabling the bridge.

tools.name: situation
tools.description: One-call orientation snapshot: discovered instances, the connected instance's product/pid/executable (plus build mtime and a dev-build heuristic when resolvable), server and manifest identity, active preset, transport, and per-cell occupancy counts. Start a session here — it collapses the connection/product/build preflight and the first design reads into one round trip. Deeper reads: get_design_overview, design_context.

tools.name: select_instance
tools.description: Choose which running MFX instance the live tools drive. Match by instanceId or port from connection_status. The launcher refuses non-MFX instances.

tools.name: get_default_locations
tools.description: Get MFX's known library paths (samples, media, presets).

tools.name: export_preset
tools.description: Export a preset as a zip file bundled with all referenced samples, written to MFX's Exports folder as <outputFolderName>.zip (get_default_locations resolves that folder). An existing folder or zip of that name is replaced, and presets belonging to a preset pack are refused.

presetPath.description: Preset path (relative to MFX library, as returned by list_presets or save_preset).

outputFolderName.description: Name for the output zip folder (without extension).

tools.name: import_preset
tools.description: Import a preset from a zip file or folder into MFX's preset library. Returns the relative path of the first imported preset, or an empty string on failure. Referenced samples are copied into the user sample folder and the preset's paths are rewritten. A name already in the library is never overwritten: the import lands as <name>_1, <name>_2 and so on. A downloaded .pampack file installs as a whole pack and returns true on success.

path.description: Absolute path to the preset zip file, folder or .pampack to import.

tools.name: capture_ui
tools.description: Render MFX's plugin UI (#app_root) to a PNG via html2canvas and return the saved file path (read it to view the image). Optionally compose the view first: gridSize (1 or 4), mainView (CellGrid|MfxRouting|CtrlAll|Envelope|LFO|ParamSeq|Mixer|PresetBrowser; omit/null = cell grid). REQUIRES MFX's window OPEN — html2canvas needs the live DOM, there is no headless renderer. Beats screen-capture: deterministic, no cursor/screen control, exact UI bitmap. View arguments switch the live editor and the previous view is not restored.

gridSize.description: Cell grid size to set before capture: 1 or 4.

mainView.description: Main view to switch to before capture (CellGrid, Mixer, LFO, …). Omit for the cell grid.

settleMs.description: Delay (ms) after view changes before rasterizing. Default 350.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms to wait for the WebView to return the image. Default 30000.

tools.name: reset_cell
tools.description: Reset a single cell's manifest parameters to their defaults and remove the envelopes whose SOURCE is this cell. Untouched: envelopes targeting this cell from another source (clear_modulations) and the cell config block (update_cell_config). Does not touch other cells.

tools.name: copy_cell
tools.description: Copy a cell's manifest parameters and remap its LFO and envelope links onto another cell, overwriting the target's. Not copied: parameter sequencers and the cell config block (sidechain source) — re-apply that with update_cell_config.

tools.name: clear_modulations
tools.description: Remove all LFO and envelope modulation links targeting a cell's parameters (or originating from that cell, for envelopes). Parameter sequencers survive — use remove_param_seq for those.

tools.name: set_effects_enabled
tools.description: Enable or bypass cell effects. Omit cellId for every cell (CTRL ALL); omit effect for the entire cell FX chain. This changes cell effect enable flags, preserving their settings and the master bus. Use set_master_effects for master-bus changes.

cellId.description: Cell number (1-4). Omit for all cells, including empty cells.

effect.description: Cell effect name, e.g. delay, crusher, fdn, filter. Omit for all cell effects.

tools.name: update_effect_config
tools.description: Toggle cell effects on/off (filter, delay, crusher, flanger, chorus, phaser, freqshift, drive, lpc, fmod, specdelay, squeeze, tape, granular, noisegate, codec, cellmix, eq, eq8, tablefilter, fdn, gate, compressor, panner, gain, vocoder, ringmod, vinylbrake, transient, repeat, pitchshift, limiter, shimmer, wavefold, resonator). granular is the Grain card and noisegate the Noise Gate. Wavefold and Resonator ship in every product. Exact availability comes from the selected product manifest. Uses the lighter KV path that does not rebuild the audio graph. Pass 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

tools.name: set_spectral_delay_curve
tools.description: Set a cell's Spectral Delay curve: 32 log-spaced bands from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, each 0..1. In TIME mode a band's value is its share of Time (0 = the shortest repeat, 1 = the whole Time); in LEVEL mode it is how much of that band is repeated. Depth scales the curve. Pass shape 'rise' (highs arrive last) or 'fall', or 32 explicit bands, low to high. Enable the effect with update_effect_config specdelayEnabled.

shape.description: A factory curve. Omit when passing bands.

bands.description: 32 values 0..1, 20 Hz first. Omit when passing shape.

tools.name: set_mfx_routing
tools.description:
Read or replace the MFX cable patch — the graph that decides which cell feeds which. MFX-only; other products return a product error.

Ports: 'input' (the host's audio in) and 'sidechain' are sources; 'output' is the destination; 'cellN' is both. A self-edge cellN→cellN is a feedback loop, and input→output is a direct dry path. Duplicate cables are dropped.

SPLIT is a three-band crossover node: cable 'input' (or 'sidechain') to 'split', then patch 'split_lo', 'split_mid' and 'split_hi' to different cells. Each band then has its own full FX rack, its own modulation and its own sidechain key — which is how you build a multiband gate or a multiband distortion here. Only 'input' and 'sidechain' may feed 'split'; the bands are sources only. Its two corner frequencies are the ordinary parameters mfx_split_lo_hz and mfx_split_hi_hz (set_parameters).

A plain serial chain on 4 cells is input→cell1, cell1→cell2, cell2→cell3, cell3→cell4, cell4→output. Parallel is input→each cell plus each cell→output.

'set' REPLACES the whole patch, so send the full cable list. Per-cable levels live in mfx_edge_gains and are left alone; a new cable takes the graph's own default (unity forward, 0.5 on a back or self edge). Re-patching rebuilds the audio graph, like reordering FX.

op.description: 'get' reads the current cables; 'set' replaces them.

edges.description: Full cable list for 'set'. An empty array clears the patch (silence).

from.description: Source port: 'input', 'sidechain', 'split_lo' / 'split_mid' / 'split_hi', or 'cellN'. 'output' and 'split' are destinations only.

to.description: Destination port: 'output', 'split', or 'cellN'. 'input', 'sidechain' and the three split bands are sources only.

tools.name: set_mfx_edge_gain
tools.description: Read or set the gain for one cable in the current MFX patch. Gain is linear: 0 is silent, 1 is unity, and 1.5 is the maximum. The cable must already exist. Other cable gains are preserved.

op.description: 'get' returns every cable gain; 'set' writes one.

from.description: Cable source for 'set': 'input', 'sidechain', 'split_lo' / 'split_mid' / 'split_hi', or 'cellN'. 'output' and 'split' are destinations only.

to.description: Cable destination for 'set': 'output', 'split', or 'cellN'. 'input', 'sidechain' and the three split bands are sources only.

tools.name: configure_mfx_combo
tools.description: Read, edit, or move one of MFX's three performance combos. Automatic assignments follow the audible patch. Manual target edits materialize and lock the assignment. setValue writes the combo parameter and its real targets in one native state update, so it works with the MFX window closed.

op.description: get reads the combo; setValue writes its value and every resolved target; rename relabels it (blank restores the role label); lock freezes the current automatic assignment as manual; unlock and rescan return it to automatic; setTargets/addTarget/removeTarget/clearTargets edit the manual target list; invertTarget swaps a target's from/to stops; setTargetStop sets one target's stop value; anchor re-derives every target's stops from the current parameter values.

value.description: Combo value (−100 to 100) for setValue, or a value in the target parameter's units for setTargetStop.

name.description: New label for rename; blank restores the role label.

tools.name: set_effect_order
tools.description:
Read or replace one cell's FX chain order. cellN_effectOrder is a JSON string array, not a numeric parameter, so set_parameters cannot reach it — this tool owns it (the set_mfx_routing precedent).

The available stages and their fresh-cell order are product-specific and come from the selected manifest; design_context reports that default order. 'set' REPLACES the chain, so send every listed stage in the order you want it to process; the array must be a permutation, not a subset (use the per-effect *Enabled flags via update_effect_config to switch stages off).

Order is audible and is a cheap way to make two otherwise identical patches sound different: filter before delay smears the resonance into the repeats, delay before filter darkens the repeats instead. Crusher before filter grinds then tames; filter before crusher grinds only what survived. Reordering rebuilds the cell's graph.

op.description: 'get' reads the current chain; 'set' replaces it.

order.description: Full product-specific chain order for 'set' — a permutation of every stage reported by design_context.

tools.name: update_cell_config
tools.description: Set one MFX cell's sidechain or Cell Mix source. A non-null sidechain source also enables that cell's compressor, and a Cell Mix source other than -1 enables its Cell Mix card.

sidechainFrom.description: Sidechain compressor source. null=no sidechain, 0=external audio input, 1-4=cell output. Auto-enables the cell's compressor when set to a non-null value.

cellmixFrom.description: Cell Mix source: -1=none, 0=external sidechain input, 1-4=another cell (never this cell). Any value but -1 also switches the cell's Cell Mix card on.

cellmixPreFx.description: Where Cell Mix taps a source cell: true=before its effects, false=after its effects and before its fader.

tools.name: set_cell_mute
tools.description: Mute, unmute, solo, or unsolo a cell in the mixer — the real channel mute/solo, cutting the whole channel (source + all effect tails) rather than pulling the volume fader down. Soloing a cell silences every other non-soloed cell until unsoloed. cell{N}_mute / cell{N}_solo are live-polled state variables (no graph rebuild). Prefer this over pulling cell{N}_volume down: a fader move leaves effect tails audible, a channel mute cuts them.

mute.description: Mute (true) or unmute (false) the cell's channel.

solo.description: Solo (true) or unsolo (false) the cell — solo silences all other non-soloed cells.

tools.name: set_master_effects
tools.description: Configure the master bus Punch compressor, Limiter, and Tape colour. The Punch compressor is a musical bus compressor — use it for glue and pump. The Limiter is a zero-latency brickwall safety stage (enable/disable only). Aim for tp <= -1 dBTP and PSR >= 8 in the loudest section; no loudness analysis tool is registered on this surface. The Tape is a vintage-tape coloration stage (ADAA tanh/asymmetric saturation + HF compression + wow/flutter), the single biggest lever for lo-fi / dusty / 'pushed' master character (hip-hop, lo-fi, Memphis, dub). Pass enabled flags to toggle each on/off. Pass parameters to shape the sound; genre recipes live in the beat-making-guide resource. Squeeze (masterSqueeze*) is the 3-band up/down density stage between Punch and Tape — for dense modern-electronic masters set masterSqueezeEnabled=1 with masterSqueezeDepth 0.2-0.4; it lifts quiet detail and limits loud bands per band (a character stage, not glue — Punch stays the glue). NOTE: the Tape and Squeeze stages require an MFX build that ships them (flat state keys, not manifest params). On older builds these keys are ignored.

masterCompOutTrim.description: Output trim in dB (default 0) — the Punch panel's Makeup knob (post-compression level, separate from masterCompMakeupGain).

masterCompMix.description: Punch parallel dry/wet (0-1, default 1 = fully compressed).

masterTapeDrive.description: Tape drive / saturation amount (0-1, default 0.5). Higher = more harmonic grit + HF compression ('push it harder → it gets duller').

masterTapeTone.description: Tape tone tilt (-1 dark .. 0 flat .. +1 bright, default 0). Go negative for dusty/lo-fi.

masterTapeMode.description: Tape character: 0=Clean (gentle tanh), 1=Lo-Fi (most degradation, dusty), 2=Broken (drifting wow/flutter, crackle, hard asymmetric drive), 3=Studio (Jiles-Atherton magnetic hysteresis — the deep hi-fi machine, no wow/hiss). Default 0.

masterTapeWear.description: Tape wear: wow/flutter pitch drift + age (0-1, default 0.5). Raise for warble/sag.

masterTapeOutTrim.description: Tape output trim dB on the wet signal, after Mix (default 0). Unity while Tape is off.

masterWidthEnabled.description: Enable the stereo utility (width + elliptical bass-mono).

masterInputTrim.description: Master input trim in dB (gain staging into the chain; default 0).

masterEqOutTrim.description: Master EQ output trim dB (default 0). Unity while the EQ is off.

masterEqTilt.description: Tilt in dB at the extremes around a 650 Hz pivot (+ = brighter; the coarse tonal-balance lever).

masterBassMonoFreq.description: Elliptical bass-mono corner Hz; < 20 = off. Engage (~100-120) when corrLow < +0.7.

masterClipEnabled.description: Enable the oversampled soft clipper (post-Tape, pre-Limiter). Its 23 samples of latency are reported whether it is on or off, so toggling it never moves the host's compensation.

masterClipDrive.description: Clipper drive dB (default 0). Staging guidance: the clipper shaves the sharpest 2-3 dB so the limiter works 1-2 dB.

masterClipMode.description: Clipper transfer: 0=Smooth (knee-tanh), 1=Silicon diode (hard knee), 2=Germanium diode (earlier, softer knee), 3=LED (higher knee). Diode modes are exact antiparallel-pair solves, ADAA at the 2x rate. Default 0.

masterDenoiseEnabled.description: Enable master noise reduction before EQ and compression; off by default. Adds one FFT frame of latency while enabled; a DAW that is playing keeps that latency after a switch-off until its transport stops, and Fixed latency mode keeps it always.

masterDenoiseOutTrim.description: Master Denoise output trim dB on the wet signal, after Mix (default 0). Unity while Denoise is off.

masterDenoisePrint.description: Learned noise print ('pdn1:<sampleRate>:<fftSize>:<base64>'), written by the Denoise panel's Learn button. Pass '' to forget it and return to adaptive tracking; copy a value read from get_state to reuse a print.

masterIronEnabled.description: Enable the console/transformer iron colour stage (post-Tape, pre-Clipper; zero latency).

masterIronDrive.description: Iron drive dB (default 0). Level-compensated — drive adds colour, not loudness.

masterIronAmount.description: Transformer (magnetizing-branch) depth 0..1 — LF-concentrated saturation, the 'iron' signature (default 0.5).

masterIronOutTrim.description: Iron output trim dB on the wet signal (default 0). Unity while Iron is off.

masterSqueezeEnabled.description: Enable Squeeze — a 3-band upward+downward compressor (post-Punch, pre-Tape; zero latency). The character (thresholds, ratios) is baked; Depth is the main lever.

masterSqueezeDepth.description: Squeeze depth 0..1 (default 0.3): scales the applied per-band gain toward the full character — a density control, NOT a dry/wet. 0.15-0.3 densifies a master; 0.6+ is the aggressive pumped sound.

masterSqueezeTime.description: Squeeze time multiplier on all band attack+release (0.1 fast .. 10 slow, default 1).

masterSqueezeTone.description: Squeeze tone: bipolar low<->high band tilt, ±6 dB at the extremes (default 0).

masterSqueezeInGain.description: Squeeze input gain dB (default 0) — drives program into the fixed thresholds (more In = more of everything).

masterSqueezeUpAmount.description: Squeeze upward-branch trim 0..1.5 (default 1). 0 disables the upward lift (downward-only multiband).

masterSqueezeDownAmount.description: Squeeze downward-branch trim 0..1.5 (default 1). 0 disables the downward limiting (pure upward lift).

masterSqueezeUpCapDb.description: Squeeze upward max-boost clamp dB (default 12) — bounds how far quiet material (tails, noise floor) is lifted.

masterLoudnessAutoReset.description: Loudness meter auto-reset on host transport start (default 1). 0 keeps measurements running across transport stops.

masterEqBells.description: The 4 parametric bells in order (defaults 200/700/2000/5000 Hz). Pass null-ish entries to skip a band.

dyn.description: Dynamic option: the band's gain rides the in-band level.

dynRange.description: Dynamic range dB (negative ducks when loud — de-harsh; default -3).

tools.name: add_param_seq
tools.description: Add a parameter sequencer (step modulation) targeting any modulatable parameter. Generates rhythmic value changes synced to transport. Steps are normalized 0-1 values. If a paramSeq already exists for this paramId, it is replaced.

sequence.description: Step values (0-1), up to 128. Defaults to 16 steps of 0.5.

freeMode.description: 0 = locked to the source cell's clock and its own steps; 1 = mapped to the Free Sequencer (its clock AND its master steps, set_free_sequencer).

stepMode.description: 0 = Clock; 1 = Gate: advance one step per trigger of the source cell (cell-locked only; MFX has no Gate).

tools.name: update_param_seq
tools.description: Update an existing parameter sequencer's step values or properties. Use add_param_seq first if no paramSeq exists for this paramId.

freeMode.description: 0 = cell-locked with its own steps; 1 = mapped to the Free Sequencer master contour (set_free_sequencer).

stepMode.description: 0 = Clock; 1 = Gate (one step per source-cell trigger; falls back to Clock when free or on MFX).

tools.name: set_free_sequencer
tools.description: Write the Free Sequencer's master step contour (top-level `freeSeqSequence`, 2..128 steps of 0..1). Every parameter sequencer mapped to it (freeMode:1 via add_param_seq / update_param_seq) follows these steps AND its clock live, each with its own strength, polarity and smoothing; cell-locked and Gate-mode sequencers keep their own steps. An empty contour restores the legacy per-sequencer behaviour.

sequence.description: Master step values, 0..1 each: 2..128 steps, or [] to clear the contour.

tools.name: remove_param_seq
tools.description: Remove a parameter sequencer for the given paramId.

tools.name: queue_variation
tools.description: Schedule a global variation switch on the next bar boundary. For an immediate switch, use load_variation instead. Optionally morph into the new section over the bars before the boundary (an already-engaged queued-flip window only; a from-idle flip hard-switches).

fadeMs.description: Crossfade duration in ms. Omit all transition options to inherit the native Bar Sync settings.

resetPhase.description: Reset pattern phase on switch. Omit to inherit native settings.

morphBars.description: Pre-anchor morph window in bars for this flip. Omit all transition options to inherit native settings.

morphMode.description: Morph style: 'param' glides continuous params (default); 'mix' equal-power blends the two sections; 'seq' adds a staged pattern dissolve to the glide (old notes lose trigger probability as new notes gain it); 'all' runs glide + dissolve + blend together; 'swap' hands whole cells over one by one across the window (MFX only; order via transition.swap.order); 'auto' lets the engine pick — mix when the sections differ in graph topology (samples, synth engines, routing) or when nothing can glide, param otherwise.

transition.description: Advanced transition settings for this flip: pattern policy for a seq/all morph, blend gain law for a mix/all morph, the Cell Swap order for a swap morph, and the outgoing section's tail. Omitted fields keep the defaults (dissolve, equalPower, left to right, fade).

swap.description: Cell Swap settings for a swap morph: order (1-based cells, leftmost first; unlisted cells follow ascending) and timing.

order.description: Cell Swap hand-over order as 1-based cell numbers (leftmost swaps first); unlisted cells follow in ascending order. Omit or [] for left to right.

timing.description: When a cell whose threshold the curve crossed hands over: 'immediate' at once (default), 'step' at the next 16th-note step, 'bar' at the next bar line, both counted back from the transition's anchor bar.

tools.name: cancel_queued_variation
tools.description: Cancel a pending bar-synced variation switch.

tools.name: update_variations
tools.description: Replace the entire 8-slot variations table with a new array. Each entry is a JSON-stringified variation snapshot (or null for an empty slot). Most agents should prefer save_variation for individual slots.

variations.description: Array of 8 entries (JSON string or null).

tools.name: variation_hold
tools.description: 'Hold while note pressed' mode for variations. Use this to map MIDI notes to momentary variation switches. Hold mode reverts when the note releases; latch mode stays.

allNotesOff.description: Force-release any held trigger notes (useful after a stuck MIDI note).

bindings.description: Per-variation-slot MIDI bindings (slot 0..7). Array is padded with unassigned slots if shorter than 8.

tools.name: update_modulation
tools.description: Apply a delta to a modulation source: LFO, Envelope, Macro, ParamSeq config, ParamSeq sequence data, or the Free Sequencer master pattern. Use add_modulation to first attach a source to a target — then this tool to edit it.

payload.description: Update payload object, one property per call. lfo, envelope, macro and paramSeq all take { index, property, value }, where index is the 0-based position in that state array (get_state section 'lfos' / 'envelopes' / 'macros' / 'paramSeqs') and property is the field name to overwrite. paramSeqSequence takes { index, sequence: number[] }. freeSeqSequence takes { sequence: number[] } — the master step contour every free-mode ParamSeq follows.

tools.name: set_metronome
tools.description: Toggle MFX's internal metronome on or off.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Merge a partial settings delta into MFX's plugin settings (the Settings panel state) and apply it live. Returns the full merged settings object so you can discover available keys. This is the only way to flip experimental-feature gates from an agent. Common boolean keys: experimentalMode, experimentalPluginHost, mcpBridgeEnabled (false closes this bridge after it replies). To enable the plugin host, set BOTH experimentalMode:true AND the specific sub-flag (e.g. experimentalPluginHost:true) in one call. Set drumSynthEnabled:false to hide its UI without muting loaded synths. Other keys include UI/library preferences — call get_state or inspect the returned object for the current set.

settings.description: Partial settings object to merge. Example: { experimentalMode: true, experimentalPluginHost: true }

tools.name: configure_transport
tools.description: Configure transport behaviour beyond BPM (use set_bpm for tempo). Set the time signature, toggle host-sync (when off, preset/user BPM overrides the host), toggle external clock sync, mute the audio output (standalone), or release host-sync ownership for manual transport. All fields are optional — only the provided ones are applied.

hostSyncEnabled.description: When false, preset/user BPM overrides the host tempo.

externalClockSync.description: Sync the internal transport to external MIDI clock.

muteAudioOutput.description: Standalone only: mute the master output.

releaseHostSyncForManualTransport.description: When true, release host-sync ownership so the internal transport can be driven manually.

tools.name: get_audio_device_setup
tools.description: Get the standalone audio/MIDI device setup (sample rate, buffer size, available and active input/output devices). Returns {pluginHosted:true} inside a DAW, which owns the device config. Use the device IDs/names from here with set_midi_io.

tools.name: get_memory_report
tools.description: Report the instance's audio memory: vfsBytes (decoded samples resident in the engine's virtual file system), vfsRetiredBytes (superseded buffers not yet reclaimed), vfsEntryCount, looperRingBytes (allocated looper capture rings), and residentBytes (whole-process RSS; residentBytesAvailable is false when the platform could not answer, in which case residentBytes is 0 rather than empty). Use it to check whether loading, replacing or auditioning samples leaves memory flat or growing.

tools.name: set_audio_device
tools.description: Switch the active audio OUTPUT device by name (standalone only — plugin-hosted builds let the DAW own the device, and the call errors there). Use the exact name from get_audio_device_setup's device list. The usual reason to call this headlessly is routing MFX into a loopback device (BlackHole, Soundflower) so a capture run records audio. MIDI devices go through set_midi_io.

deviceName.description: Output device name exactly as listed by get_audio_device_setup.

tools.name: set_midi_io
tools.description: Select MIDI input/output devices (standalone). get_audio_device_setup lists them under midiInputs / midiOutputs (and each port's device under midiOutputPorts); pass each device's identifier or exact name. Ports B-D are extra outputs a cell can pick with update_cell_config midiOutPort. All fields optional.

inputDeviceIds.description: MIDI inputs to enable, by identifier or name. Replaces the active set; [] disables all inputs.

outputDeviceId.description: MIDI output device, by identifier or name; "" selects none.

outputPortDeviceIds.description: Devices for Ports B, C and D in order, by identifier or name; "" leaves a port with no device.

tools.name: set_midi_mapping
tools.description: Configure the global MIDI-controller mappings that trigger MFX actions: variation switch and preset change. Set the enable flag, MIDI channel, CC number, source (Program Change or CC), or bar-sync for each target. One field per call.

field.description: Field to set. 'source' (0 = Program Change, 1 = CC) applies to preset and variation; 'barSync' is variation-only.

value.description: boolean for enabled/barSync; number for channel (1-16), ccNumber (0-127), or source (0 = Program Change, 1 = CC).

tools.name: delete_preset
tools.description: Delete a user preset file from disk. Factory presets are protected and cannot be deleted. Use the relative path returned by list_presets.

tools.name: set_preset_factory_status
tools.description: Mark a preset as factory (read-only) or user (editable) on disk. Affects the factory flag and the file location.

instructions: MFX is a four-cell modular FX router: cells are patched with cables and each cell runs its own effect chain. Use cells 1-4. Treat tool annotations as authoritative and use select_instance when several products are running.
